name: cdk-overlay
description: Uses the CDK Overlay service to render a component into a floating, positioned layer above the page — the same primitive MatMenu/MatTooltip/MatSelect build on — closing it on backdrop click.
notes: OverlayRef.dispose() must be called explicitly (e.g. on backdropClick or ngOnDestroy) — an attached overlay is not removed automatically when its triggering component is destroyed, which leaks a detached DOM node and its component instance.
hasBackdrop: true is what makes backdropClick() emit at all; without it the overlay has no backdrop element and clicking outside the panel does nothing.
Passing the triggering component's own ViewContainerRef to ComponentPortal gives the projected component access to the same dependency injectors as the rest of the page, rather than an isolated one.
